title: Redact sensitive content in an uncommitted event record through kbs
description: Event files are append-only, so when LeftBlock blocks an uncommitted event for content such as a home path, the only fix today is to delete and recreate the issue, which fails once the issue itself is committed. Add a spec-first kbs command that rewrites the flagged content in an event that has not been committed yet (refusing committed events), with Python and Rust parity. Current cases in this repo: project/events/2026-09-02T12-42-03.073Z__133c20ef-9306-49ae-a74c-63b846fd49b7.json and project/events/2026-10-03T16-04-01.745Z__70b5382f-a805-4233-9eca-e2fe62891af0.json (leftblock-home-path-posix), left untracked. Suggested by the Biblicus session via the LeftBlock owner.
